claims.statement: Knowledge impact and context relevance read untracked paths as Git normal-mode entries: a wholly untracked directory is one disclosed entry, while changed tracked file names stay exact and a cited source or target path under an entry is still matched by exact prefix. Live review keeps full file-level expansion because it selects individual new files.

attributes.scope: Delegated construction choice within ADR 0031; knowledge queries only, not live review path selection
attributes.claim_ceiling: One measured Windows checkout, one repo shape and scratch probes; independent-agent benefit NOT TESTED and timings are environment-specific
attributes.rejected_alternative: Expand every untracked file by default; exact but spent about 30 seconds per knowledge query on a checkout with 54,765 untracked files, and those file names cannot change cited-source overlap because cited sources are committed at the indexed revision.
